name: What is the process for a closet remodel with Maine Results, Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a closet remodel with Maine Results, Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our closet remodel process starts with an initial consultation where we discuss your storage needs, style preferences, and budget. Next, our designers create a custom plan and 3D renderings for your approval. Once the design is finalized and materials are selected, we schedule the installation. Our team handles everything from demolition of existing structures to the precise installation of your new custom closet. We strive to maintain clear communication throughout to ensure the project meets your expectations and our high standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes an initial consultation, custom design and renderings, material selection, and professional installation by our team.
